page.overview:
What is Until It Sleeps?

Until It Sleeps is a song created by the heavy metal band Metallica. It is the fourth track of their 1996 album Load. Live it's the only true duet between James and recent bassist Jason Newsted.

The theme and lyrics of the song deal with James' mother, specifically, her losing battle with cancer. The song is very personal to James, due to it being associated with his mother.

Where do I take this pain of mine I run, but it stays right my side So tear me open, pour me out There's things inside that scream and shout And the pain still hates me So hold me, until it sleeps Just like the curse, just like the stray You feed it once, and now it stays So tear me open, but beware There's things inside without a care And the dirt still stains me So wash me, until I'm clean It grips you, so hold me It stains you, so hold me It hates you, so hold me It holds you, so hold me Until it sleeps** So tell me why you've chosen me Don't want your grip, don't want your greed I'll tear me open, make you gone No more can you hurt anyone And the fear still shakes me So hold me, until it sleeps

I don't want it So tear me open, but beware The things inside without a care And the dirt still stains me So wash me, 'till I'm clean... I'll tear me open, make you gone No longer will you hurt anyone And the fear still shapes me So hold me, until it sleeps... Until it sleeps...
